domain: Clock fields and elapsed are JavaScript Number values represented as binary64
Clock has ordinary data fields; nonthrowing trace setters observe writes without changing values
The tick callback may update next_tick and tick_interval; mutations are visible to the following loop
Only terminating inputs and callbacks are supported; zero/negative intervals can leave the original source in an infinite loop
Repeated additions are preserved exactly; replacing them with ceil or division is not assumed equivalent
Callbacks and observers do not reenter updateLocalBattleEngine
NaN payload and sign are diagnostic; all non-NaN numeric fields require raw bit equality
protocol: nextTickBits intervalBits elapsedBits mode nextMutationBits intervalMutationBits; mode0none,1next,2interval,3both(next then interval)

trace.numericPolicy: Default semantic NaN classification with explicit mismatch counts; --strict-bits requires raw NaN bits too
